{{Quote|Did I ever tell you about the time Chewbacca and I were in the treasure vaults of...|Han Solo|<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
A '''complex of treasure vaults''' was built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] by the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] despot, [[Xim/Legends|Xim]]. A message inscribed above the façade of the vaults declared them a homage to Xim, and they were created to hold the riches it was expected he would amass from his [[Xim Wars|war]] against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]; however, the conflict ended with the despot's defeat at the [[Third Battle of Vontor|Third Battle]] on the world [[Vontor]], and so the vaults were never filled. Many [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] after the vaults were built, the historian [[Bleys Harand]] visited them in his quest to view an accurate depiction of Xim. However, he found no such image in the complex or elsewhere on his journey, which he documented in his book ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]''.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

The treasure of Xim the despot was eventually [[Mission to Dellalt|discovered]] in the vaults by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="HSatLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
